advice: Experiment: replace the full512 kernel’s 128 KiB packed-A scratch path with an output-tile SME path. For each output tile, transpose a small FP32 A tile in ZA, then use that tile for MOPA before writing it to scratch; keep FP32 accumulation and the existing ABI. Count each repeated A transpose for every output-column tile, plus all scratch reads, writes, allocation, and SME transitions, in the timed call. Compare the complete path against fresh unchanged controls. This is a new implementation direction; no gain is established.
risks: This needs a new compute path, not a small wrapper edit. Repeating A transposes across output-column tiles may cost more than the full pack, and scratch traffic may erase any benefit. Preserve general sizes, tails, n<=0, tolerance, thread count, and the complete LIBXSMM BSD notice. Check full-GEMM correctness and bounds, then use repeated paired measurements with the block’s power mode and settings unchanged. Do not attribute a noisy outcome to transpose fusion alone.
